JPersist Persistence Tools Core API Reference

Persistence Tools Core API & SPI

The Persistence Tools API module (io.github.jpersist.tools.api) provides vendor-agnostic abstractions and Service Provider Interfaces (SPI) for build-time validation, query parsing, schema verification, and bytecode enhancement of JPA persistence artifacts.

By decoupling application tooling and build plugins from specific JPA provider implementations, this module enables consistent build-time analysis across different persistence specifications (e.g. Jakarta Persistence JPA 3.x and legacy Java Persistence JPA 2.x).

Architecture & Key Contracts

The API is divided into two primary package layers:

1. Public API Contracts (persistence.tools)

Defines the consumer-facing interfaces and data models for persistence tooling:

  • Enhancer — Transforms compiled entity class bytecode at build time to incorporate runtime optimizations such as lazy-loading proxies, inline dirty tracking, and bidirectional association management.
  • NamedObjectParser — Validates named JPQL queries and stored procedure declarations against the entity metamodel, returning rich metadata descriptors.
  • SchemaValidator — Validates the entity metamodel against a live database schema via JDBC connections.
  • NamedObjectDescriptor — Immutable descriptor encapsulating the validation results, target type, query/procedure name, and extracted parameter definitions.
  • NamedObjectType — Enumeration classifying named persistence objects (QUERY or STORED_PROCEDURE).
  • PersistenceLinter — Common marker interface for all persistence linting components.

2. Service Provider Interfaces (persistence.tools.spi)

Defines the factory interfaces and runtime discovery mechanisms implemented by provider modules:

  • PersistenceServiceProvider — Common root SPI for version-to-namespace mapping and ServiceLoader-based factory resolution.
  • EnhancerProvider — Factory SPI for discovering and instantiating namespace-specific bytecode enhancers.
  • NamedObjectParserFactory — Factory SPI for creating named object query and procedure parsers.
  • SchemaValidatorFactory — Factory SPI for creating database schema validators.
  • PersistenceLinterFactory — Generic base factory SPI for discovering linter factory subtypes.

Service Discovery and Usage

Bytecode Enhancement

Obtain an enhancer for a specific JPA specification version (e.g. "3.1") via EnhancerProvider.getEnhancerProvider(String): 


EnhancerProvider provider = EnhancerProvider.getEnhancerProvider("3.1");
Enhancer enhancer = provider.getEnhancer(
    classpathFiles,
    Map.of("enhancement.option.lazy-initialization", true,
           "enhancement.option.dirty-tracking", true));

byte[] enhancedBytes = enhancer.enhance("com.example.Order", originalBytecode);

Named Query and Stored Procedure Validation

Obtain a parser factory via NamedObjectParserFactory.newNamedObjectParserFactory(String): 


NamedObjectParserFactory factory = NamedObjectParserFactory.newNamedObjectParserFactory("3.1");
try (NamedObjectParser parser = factory.newNamedObjectParser(entityClassNames)) {
    NamedObjectDescriptor queryDesc = parser.parseQuery(
        "Order.findByStatus", "SELECT o FROM Order o WHERE o.status = :status");

    NamedObjectDescriptor procDesc = parser.parseStoredProcedure(
        "Order.archive", "sp_archive_orders", Set.of("cutoffDate"));
}

Database Schema Validation

Obtain a schema validator factory via newSchemaValidatorFactory(String): 


SchemaValidatorFactory factory = SchemaValidatorFactory.newSchemaValidatorFactory("3.1");
SchemaValidator validator = factory.newSchemaValidator(entityClassNames);
validator.validateSchema(Map.of(
    "driver",   "org.h2.Driver",
    "url",      "jdbc:h2:mem:testdb",
    "username", "sa",
    "password", ""));

Java Platform Module System (JPMS)

The io.github.jpersist.tools.api module descriptor exports its API packages and declares ServiceLoader dependencies:

  • exports persistence.tools;
  • exports persistence.tools.spi;
  • uses persistence.tools.spi.PersistenceServiceProvider;
  • uses persistence.tools.spi.PersistenceLinterFactory;
  • uses persistence.tools.spi.NamedObjectParserFactory;
  • uses persistence.tools.spi.SchemaValidatorFactory;
  • uses persistence.tools.spi.EnhancerProvider;
